summary: Exporter implemented and VM gates green; unrestricted exact-time serialization is blocked by the existing f64 parser.
body:
Changed files:

- [scene/export.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/export/crates/interchange/src/scene/export.rs): bounded exporter, mappings, version selection and detection helper.
- [scene/export/tests.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/export/crates/interchange/src/scene/export/tests.rs): 28 tests with inline, hand-worked expectations.
- [scene/mod.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/export/crates/interchange/src/scene/mod.rs): only `pub mod export;`.
- [lib.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/export/crates/interchange/src/lib.rs): permitted Format::Scene and dispatch changes only.

API:

```rust
pub(crate) fn export(
    p: &Project,
    seq_id: ItemId,
    opts: &ExportOptions,
    report: &mut Report,
) -> Result<String>
```

Reachable through the existing public `filmcraft_interchange::export(..., Format::Scene, ...)`. ExportOptions is unchanged. Scene import returns the requested not-implemented error.

**Blocking precision issue:** `32768 + 1/24` seconds is a valid 24 fps boundary whose Tick cannot be recovered through the existing f64-based `values::seconds`. Additional decimal digits cannot supply a missing f64 value. The wider property test exposed this; [the regression](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/export/crates/interchange/src/scene/export/tests.rs:428) preserves it. Current behaviour reports and skips unrepresentable intervals. The unrestricted requirement needs an integrator-approved precision policy or changes outside this scope. It is not fully satisfied.

Design decisions and ambiguities:

| Emitted construct | Minimum | Gate |
|---|---|---|
| Media/text assets, layers, shapes, groups, animation, audioMix/audioTrack | 1.0 | XSD introduction permits newer attributes on 1.0 elements |
| Markers, captions | 1.1 | V1 |
| Transitions | 1.1 | V3 |

Each gated construct has a validation test proving its minimum version and failure after decrementing it. Plain clips declare 1.0.

- XSD `transformAttributes`: anchors remain in source coordinates; fit-to-frame is folded into scale. Shape anchors additionally account for FilmCraft’s centred rectangle coordinates.
- XSD `animateType`/`keyType`: explicit local time base and outgoing interpolation. Cubic-bezier control points preserve FilmCraft’s handle-based easing; its Ease Out differs from sr-core’s named ease-out curve. Key times follow the plan’s clip-relative convention. The architecture document’s media-time description should be reconciled during importer integration.
- XSD `audioTrackType` has no end attribute: source trims and speed determine duration. Its dB gain preserves amplification beyond volume’s 0–1 range. Picture layers mute implicit video audio to prevent duplication. Nested audio is trimmed and mapped to the root timeline.
- Nested visual groups use `child = start + (t - start - timeOffset) * timeScale`, following scene-render’s `sr-eval/src/program.rs`, `Clock::Affine` and `group_clock`.
- XSD `transitionType`: explicit linear curves preserve cross-dissolve timing. Unknown transition types become reported cross dissolves; windows incompatible with sibling cuts are reported and skipped.
- XSD positive project duration requires an empty sequence to use one frame. FilmCraft has no independent sequence-duration field for trailing blank time.
- XML-illegal controls become reported U+FFFD replacements; legal whitespace survives through character references.

Reported omissions include unsupported effects/masks, adjustment layers, multicam, reversed/held nests, audio transitions, mixer routing/automation, advanced graphic appearance/content animation, caption styling, and nested captions/markers. Bounds cover output size, attributes, expanded content and nesting.

Borrowing: no external source code copied. Group-clock semantics were consulted in `/home/admin/src/scene-render/crates/sr-eval/src/program.rs`, revision `9ebe0889b946aea2bbb8156c1fa0bfbd2b405b84`. Easing was adapted from FilmCraft’s own `crates/project/src/keyframe.rs`. No dependencies or assets were added.

TDD log — names below have prefix `scene_export_`:

- Initial red: `one_clip`, `trim_speed_and_reverse`, `track_paint_order_and_dedup`, `motion_anchor`, `opacity_keys_outgoing_ease`, `transition_gate`, `markers_gate`, `captions_gate`, `text_and_rect`, `nested_group`, `rational_rate`, `empty_missing_and_hostile`, `xml_escaping_paths`, `audio_gain_mute_and_trim`, `reports_unsupported_and_cycles` returned `Other("stub")`. `dispatch_and_detection` returned Fcp7Xml instead of Scene. `seconds_on_common_grids` returned Tick(0) instead of Tick(10584000000). Green: 17/17.
- Second red: `nested_audio_clock` lacked audioTrack; `shape_anchor_and_animation` lacked animation; `animated_limits_are_reported` wrote opacity 2 instead of 1. Green after fixes. The wider `full_duration_frame_grids` test exposed the unresolved precision issue; it was replaced with `full_duration_exact_or_reported` plus a fixed regression, not claimed as unrestricted success. Batch green: 24/24.
- Third red: `path_shape` and `large_hold_uses_no_artificial_tick_span` lacked their nodes; `animated_audio_can_rise_from_silence` wrote mute=true instead of false. Green: 27/27.
- Final red: `detection_utf8_at_sniff_boundary` returned None instead of Scene. Fixed and green in the full suite.

Final VM command passed: clippy with `-D warnings`; **151 tests passed** (92 unit, 59 integration, including 28 exporter tests); **wasm passed for 50 crates**. [Final log](/tmp/filmcraft-export-final-vm.log). No local builds/tests, commits or pushes. Coordination locks released.

Integrator notes: no exhaustive Format matches outside scope require repair. Engine format parsing automatically accepts Scene via Format::ALL, but menus do **not** list it automatically. S8 still needs `crates/engine/src/interchange.rs:13` (.scene allowlist), `crates/engine/src/commands.rs:1475` (command metadata/menu wiring), and `crates/ui-egui/src/lib.rs:1276` (import filter). Import dispatch remains intentionally stubbed; round-trip tests remain deferred.
